security.title: Trust is
security.subtitle: Your CV and letters stay yours. Encryption, row-level access, and review-before-send are built into every layer — not bolted on.

items.title: Encrypted at rest
items.desc: Personal data and documents are encrypted and never sold or shared with third parties.

items.title: Row-level access
items.desc: Every request is authenticated. You only ever see your own missions, drafts, and profile.

items.title: You approve first
items.desc: Nothing is sent on your behalf. Human-in-the-loop is the default, not an option.

items.title: Private by design
items.desc: We keep the surface small: resume, job context, and the letter you choose to keep.

control.title: Built with you.
control.subtitle: Agents do the research and the first draft. You keep the judgment — edit, rewrite, or approve before anything leaves your desk.

items.title: Tone memory
items.desc: Feedback compounds. The more you review, the more it sounds like you.

items.title: Gap reports
items.desc: See exactly where you match and where you don't — then decide how to position it.

items.title: Critic scores
items.desc: Structure, relevance, and tone scored before you even open the draft.

items.title: Rewrite loops
items.desc: Ask for a pass. Watch the pipeline rerun. Keep the version that feels right.

items.quote: I dropped my CV and Ariadne matched me with 5 roles I actually wanted. The cover letters were better than anything I'd written myself.
items.author: Sarah J.

items.quote: After two applications, the agent started writing exactly like me — but sharper. The tone of voice memory is a game-changer.
items.author: Michael T.

items.quote: I used to spend 2 hours per application. Now it takes me 5 minutes to review and approve. I landed 3 interviews in my first week.
items.author: Elena R.

items.a: Yes. You can generate applications for free with no credit card required. We offer premium tiers for high-volume users and advanced features.

items.q: Does it work for any industry?
items.a: Absolutely. Semantic matching works across tech, finance, healthcare, consulting, creative roles, and more. It analyzes skills and context — not industry templates.

items.q: Will the cover letters sound generic?
items.a: No. The Writer Agent learns your tone from your feedback. After two or three reviews, it adapts to your voice.
Your CV and personal data are encrypted and never shared with third parties. We use Supabase authentication and row-level access policies.

items.q: Can I edit the generated letters?
items.a: Of course. Every draft goes through your review — edit, request a rewrite, or approve before anything is finalized.
